test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the highest mountain in Bhutan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gangkhar Puensum**.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Gangkhar Puensum is the highest point in Bhutan and the highest unclimbed mountain in the world.
 
• Other important peaks:
 
 
• Mount Everest is the world's highest mountain.
 
• The Sandakphu is the highest peak in West Bengal.
 
• The Doddabetta is the highest peak of Tamilnadu.
 
• Deomali is the highest mountain peak in Odhisha.
 
• The highest Mountain in Victoria is Mount Bogong.
 
• Kalsubai Shikhar is the highest mountain peak in Maharashtra.
 
• Nanda Devi is the highest mountain in Uttarakhand.
 
• Kangchenjunga is the highest peak in India & the third highest summit in the World.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kula Kangri:**

 
 
• It is one of the loftiest mountain peaks of the Himalayas Mountain like Chomolhari and Manaslu.
 
 
 
• **Gipmochi :**
 
 
• This mountain lies between China, Bhutan, and the Indian state of Sikkim.
 
• Gipmochi mountain is also known as **Gyemo Chen**.
 
• Gyemo Chen is called The Great Queen in the local language.
 
• It is a part of the Greater Himalayas.
 
• The mountain is located at the** tri-junction of China, Bhutan, and India.**
